verdict.rationale: Bolna documents self-hosting on your own servers with Docker or Kubernetes, and its GitHub repo describes Bolna as an open source framework, so the product itself provides a self-host path. The self-host docs sit under the enterprise section, and the pack shows only a one-line summary of them, so how much of the hosted product can be self-hosted is unproven. missing for 10: detailed self-host setup steps, parity between the open-source framework and the hosted platform (dashboard, Agent Studio, telephony), whether self-hosting needs an enterprise agreement, independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments.
Bolna is the end-to-end open source production ready framework for quickly building LLM based voice driven conversational applications.
